title: Vibrant Tagine Pasta
description: A flavorful and colorful pasta dish inspired by the traditional North African tagine. This recipe is perfect for a quick and easy weeknight dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the vibrant peppers and tagine herbs to the skillet and sauté for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Add the smoked paprika and cook for 1 minute.
Drain the cooked pasta and add it to the skillet with the vegetables and herbs.
Toss the pasta to combine and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: garnish with additional tagine herbs or vibrant peppers for added color and flavor.
